findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 in the request body can crash the middleware outside the JSON parse guard
findings.evidence: The body is decoded with Buffer.toString before entering the try/catch, so malformed byte sequences can throw and bypass the intended 400 response path.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the decode step in the same try/catch as JSON.parse, or use a decoder strategy that converts malformed input into a controlled 400 response instead of throwing from the event handler.

findings.title: Prefix match accepts non-JSON media types such as application/jsonp
findings.evidence: The content-type gate only checks whether the header starts with application/json, which also matches other media types sharing that prefix.
findings.recommendation: Parse the media type and require an exact match for application/json, or explicitly allow only application/json plus valid parameters such as ; charset=utf-8.
